notes.title: 0.1.8 Cog System and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
"0.1.8 - Cog System and Bug Fixes
- Added a cog-based logic system. This includes timers, logic gates, dart traps, a new cog workbench item, recievers, pressure plates, levers, a wall button, and now all light sources can be turned on and off (except the beacons). This new system works on ""pulses"". Levers, buttons, and pressure plates emit pulses when you activate them. This pulse surges through all cogs that are touching the tile you activated. If an object (door, light source, dart trap, explosive barrel, reciever, timer) is connected to the cog network, it will toggle it's state (or explode if it's an explosive barrel). Timers that are in the ""on"" state constantly emit pulses. Timers can be manually turned on by interacting with them. Timers are the only items whose state will reset when the game closes. Also, timers that are activated most recently will fire FIRST. This means timers can chain. Logic gates work by assessing any recievers that are directly connected to them. They'll change their output (at their position) based on the on or off state of these nearby recievers. Unlike the video I sent in the patreon chat, these now send a pulse both when they activate, and when they deactivate. So if an  ""AND"" gate has all of it's nearby recievers turn on, it'll send a pulse. But then if one of them goes off, it'll send another pulse. This seems counter-intuitive, but is actually more intuitive when you're using it. 
- Added an advanced crafting table item. You can no longer craft as much stuff by hand and need to use the table. 
- Added a worm enemy underground
- Fixed a bug where some AOE effects don't do damage
- Fixed a bug where the living flame enemies are invisible
- Fixed a bug where you can avoid heat damage by dodging
- Fixed various other typos and bugs. There are still a handful I haven't gotten to. 

I would LOVE to hear what ideas you guys have for improvements to the logic system. For the most part, I do what terraria does. I'd also like to hear any ideas for new things that can operate with it. I think it would be cool to have something that could take items from nearby stuff (like furnaces and harvestable crops) and place things into nearby chests. But that's more a ""later on"" thing, I think."

This new system works on "pulses". Levers, buttons, and pressure plates emit pulses when you activate them. This pulse surges through all cogs that are touching the tile you activated. If an object (door, light source, dart trap, explosive barrel, reciever, timer) is connected to the cog network, it will toggle it's state (or explode if it's an explosive barrel). Timers that are in the "on" state constantly emit pulses. Timers can be manually turned on by interacting with them. Timers are the only items whose state will reset when the game closes. They'll change their output (at their position) based on the on or off state of these nearby recievers. notes.title: 0.0.54 - New furnaces, quality of life, bug fixes
notes.content:
"0.0.54 - New furnaces, quality of life, bug fixes

- Furnaces now work much like Minecraft instead of being instantaneous. I've gone back and forth on this a few times. They started out where you could only put one item in at a time and it would slowly bake. Then I decided to make it instant for any quantity. Now it takes some time. Different furnaces can have different speeds, same with different materials. Gold ore should take longer than iron, etc. 
- Quick stack, loot all, and deposit all buttons have been added to containers
- ""Deposit to nearby chests"" and ""Quick stack to nearby chests"" buttons have been added to player inventory. 
- You can now throw items by pressing T
- Hoes now get locked into a mode when you first begin to hold the button. I'm curious how y'all will feel about this one. It feels more intuitive, but not at the same time. 
- Added a ""save and continue"" button
- Fixed the stupid bug where you can't plant crops. I broke them when fixing another issue where you could place wood floor under an existing crop. both issues should be resolved."

notes.title: 0.0.41 - Bug Fixes and Starts of a New Holiday
notes.content:
0.0.41 - Bug Fixes and Starts of a New Holiday

- We've been having a bug where the sword destroys an object but never completes it's "damage" process, gettings stuck during region generation. I've padded it with debug statements to hopefully figure out what's causing it. 
- If you press the "U" key, the game skips forward one month. I was getting tired of pressing the "y" key over and over again. 
- On winter day 27, a hatch should appear in the town square leading to an arena. Right now it's just populated with dirt, but I'll eventually put a cool arena there where the goblins can host a fight ring to see how long the player survives. This actually took quite a bit of work, I had to make it so maps could be non-uniform, and had to make it so elevators could send you locations that change (if the town square moves, for example, the elevator works differently). Since elevators are deeply integrated with pathfinding, this was difficult. I would not be suprised if I broke multi-floor pathfinding, but we'll find out later. 
- The town square can no longer be destroyed on holidays. 

NOTE - Old islands will no longer be compatible due to the new floor, and how elevator data gets saved.

notes.title: 0.0.34 - Seasons and bug fixes
notes.content:
0.0.34

- Made it so crops can only be planted during certain seasons, and will die if the season ever changes into one where they cannot survive
- Made it so some fish will spawn in certain seasons. Currently, none of the fish actually implement this. Need more fish. 
- Fixed a bug where having vanity armor would result in gizmos not appearing until the inventory opened
- Whenever a tile gets unloaded offscreen, it used to save them in a dictionary so they could be respawned. This dictionary would come to hold over 30,000 tiles now that we have many unique tiles. This would mean 30,000 gameobjects would be instantiated, resulting in likely crashes on machines with less RAM. I have capped this list at 2,000 tiles. Any more, and it will begin to destroy them slowly in the background (10 per frame). Should reduce the number of crashes.
- There used to be no cap on the amount of item drops. There can now only be 400 at a time. If over 400 are spawned, it will destroy the oldest ones to reach 400. 
- I have made it so drinking multiple of the same potion no longer stacks - it WILL extend the amount of time that the potion effect is active, but you can no longer get a 50% mining speed bonus from drinking a ton of 10% mining speed  increase potions, for example. Instead, you will get +3 minutes (or whatever the duration is) to the effect for each one. 
- Fixed a bug where light orbs caused major lag spikes
- Re-added the auto save feature to save every 5 mins (not yet toggleable)
- Fixed a bug where the save and quit button would say "close" in-game instead of "save and quit".
- Fixed an issue with the mushroom chest becoming invisible on open
- Manually reimported all the enemy sprites, so they HOPEFULLY shouldn't flicker.
